title: Add descriptions for heur dissector tables
description:
Build on !13975 to add human-readable descriptions for all heuristic
dissector tables in Wireshark.

Chosen names are meant to give some info on when a heuristic dissector
lookup will be made. Terms like 'fallback' are used when the heuristic
is only consulted if other checks do not result in dissection, for
example.

People with more intimate knowledge of the protocols and dissectors
involved are encouraged to suggest or implement better descriptions.

notes.body: [The line in question](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/bcfa25bdfc5066c66b5305770582413229524fba/epan/dissectors/packet-geonw.c#L425) is in the function `dissect_btpb()`, and the `btpb_heur_subdissector_list` is not used otherwise in this file, so I believe this was a tpyo in the original code.
As noted I'm not an expert in this protocol and am willing to be corrected if this is an intentional use of `btpa...`.
I don't know either just noted the difference.
